mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.dept_id, r.study_rate_min, r.exam_pass_times, r.enabled, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_time, d.dept_name FROM promotion_rule r LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = r.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: ORDER BY (r.dept_id IS NOT NULL) ASC, r.dept_id ASC, r.id ASC
WHERE r.dept_id IS NULL ORDER BY r.enabled DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion_rule (dept_id, study_rate_min, exam_pass_times, enabled, create_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{deptId}, #{studyRateMin}, #{examPassTimes}, #{enabled}, #{createBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE promotion_rule SET study_rate_min = #{studyRateMin}, exam_pass_times = #{examPassTimes}, enabled = #{enabled}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
